input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: Section 12 gives an express conformance-to-Specifications warranty for the acceptance period plus one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and continuing for as long as the Software remains under Maintenance Services — at or beyond the preferred 12-month software warranty. Real remedies are provided: correction during acceptance testing (§6(b)), best-efforts repair at no charge under Software Repair Service (p0077), and, on rejection, return of all amounts paid to Garman (§7–§8). There is no "AS IS" language and no disclaimer of implied or other warranties anywhere in the Agreement, so nothing swallows the express warranty, and the §15 liability cap preserves direct damages. Minor preferred sub-elements are absent (no express professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty, and Software Repair Service is qualified by best efforts and chargeable-cause carve-outs); we note these but they do not defeat the fallback, so no redline.
